description: The plot illustrates loss ratio (in percent) as a function of compute measured in TFLOPs for five methods/variants. The x-axis is labeled “TFLOPs,” uses a logarithmic scale, and spans from 1e7 to 9e8 with tick labels shown at 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled “Loss Ratio (%)” on a linear scale, with labeled ticks from 95 to 100 at 1-unit intervals (the plotted lines extend slightly below 95 for the lowest series). The “Vanilla” line is purple with triangle markers and a solid line, staying flat at 100% across all TFLOPs. “SepLLM (n=64)” is orange with plus markers and a solid line, starting around 98.3% at 1e7, rising to about 100.0% by 2e8, peaking near 100.4% at 4e8, and ending around 99.9% at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=128)” is blue with x markers and a solid line, starting near 97.0% at 1e7, increasing to about 99.9% by 2e8, then hovering close to 100% with small dips (around 99.8–99.9%) and ending near 99.8% at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=64, H)” is green with diamond markers and a solid line, beginning around 97.5% at 1e7, reaching about 100.0% by 4e8, showing a small high point around 100.2% at 6e8, and finishing near 99.9% at 9e8. “SepLLM (n=64, H/T)” is red with circle markers and a solid line, starting lowest near 94.0% at 1e7, rising to about 98.0% at 1e8 and about 99.1% at 4e8, dipping to roughly 98.5% at 5e8, returning to about 99.0% at 6e8–7e8, and ending around 98.7% at 9e8.
